description.p: AudioStrada is a digital audio workstation: multitrack recording and editing, a mixing console with buses and VCAs, automation, CLAP, VST3 and LV2 plugins running in their own processes, MIDI instruments with a piano roll, built-in effects including a Neural Amp Modeler amp, time stretching, and export to WAV and FLAC.
On Linux it plays through PipeWire with no configuration, and also supports JACK and ALSA.
